messages:
Raj (Hiring Manager): New manager starts next Mon. Can we have a 1-page manager handoff pack (day-by-day first week checklist, who-to-ask shortcuts, and a 30/60/90 paragraph set) that I can paste into the offer/email? Need a tiny 1:1 agenda snippet too.

Priya: I can draft — keeping it super short so recruiters can paste. Plan: 1) pre-start items, 2) Day 1 schedule, 3) first-week focus list, 4) 30/60/90 copy, 5) 1:1 agenda snippet, 6) quick ping list.

Jordan (IT): Note: manager laptop lead time 3 business days. If you need same-week start we can enable a temporary managed laptop image and ship later; need full legal name + personal email.

Sam (DevEx): I'll add two CLI lines for requesting repo invites and CI tokens and a note about deploy perms ramping (read -> merge -> deploy).

Priya: Draft below (single-paragraph + checklist):

"Welcome blurb (paste-friendly):
Welcome! On Day 1 you'll have a 30-minute orientation with your manager, team intros, and access to code, CI, and monitoring. We'll share a 10-day leadership sprint and a draft 30/60/90 within the first week to align expectations.

Pre-start (before Day 1):
- HR e-sign + benefits link (People Ops)
- Confirm laptop or enable managed VM (IT)
- Add to Slack, Google Workspace, Confluence (People Ops)

Day 1 (AM):
- 30m orientation with hiring manager: role scope, top 3 priorities (Manager)
- 15m team intros (Manager)
- Laptop SSO, MFA, email setup (IT)

Day 1 (PM):
- Access checklist: GitHub org, JIRA, CI, Datadog, Redwood Console (DevEx/IT)
- Schedule weekly 1:1s & send 1:1 agenda (Manager)

First week focus (Days 2-7):
- Meet direct reports & skip-levels; map ownership (Manager)
- Product & architecture walkthroughs (Tech Leads)
- Run through incident runbook + paging flow (Eng-SRE)
- Complete mandatory security training (Security)
- Quick win: unblock top prioritized ticket (Manager/New Hire)

30/60/90 (paste-ready sentences):
- 30d: Understand team structure, run regular 1:1s, and close onboarding gaps.
- 60d: Deliver an agreed milestone, propose one process improvement.
- 90d: Own next-quarter planning and present hiring/resource asks.

One-line 1:1 agenda (first meeting):
- 1: personal check-in (5m), 2: role expectations & immediate priorities (10m), 3: support & blockers (10m), 4: next steps + schedule cadence (5m).

Quick ping list: IT (Jordan) - laptop/SSO; DevEx (Sam) - repo/CI; People Ops (Nina) - benefits/1:1 scheduling; Eng-SRE - on-call/runbook; Security - mandatory trainings.

Sam (DevEx): CLI snips to include for devs: `devex request-invite --email <email> --team eng-managers` and `devex request-token --service ci --scope repo`. Also add note: deploy perms ramp over 30 days.

Priya: I'll paste this into Confluence and add links to templates + the 1:1 doc. Will drop final link here by EOD Thu.

Nina (People Ops): Thanks all. Raj, send me start date + legal name and I'll kick off HR and IT flows.

onboard-bot: IT ticket created #IT-90231 for laptop provisioning (ETA 3 business days).

Raj (Hiring Manager): Perfect, thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
